recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a future incorrect ca-hc-npn OID is found in HL7 Terminology/THO, address it through the THO/UTG source of truth rather than reintroducing the removed external row into FHIR core.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive vocabulary issue requesting the OID associated with http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/ca-hc-npn be changed from the duplicate Health Canada DIN OID to 2.16.840.1.113883.5.1107.
initial_application: Git 54f9e4d originally registered the ca-hc-npn row with the duplicate 2.16.840.1.113883.5.1105 OID. Git ade907ca, a vocabulary R5 batch commit explicitly listing FHIR-30280, changed the source/terminologies-systems.html ca-hc-npn row to 2.16.840.1.113883.5.1107.
additional_context: FHIR-37853 later updated the same active Code Systems page to make HL7 Terminology/THO the authoritative source of truth for external terminology details and removed rows such as ca-hc-npn from FHIR core. The current source/terminologies-systems.html page remains in build scope but no longer contains the ca-hc-npn row, while checked-in V3 terminology/OID sources still record HC-NPN with OID 2.16.840.1.113883.5.1107.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit is needed because the requested correction was applied and there is no remaining current core source row with the wrong duplicate OID.
